about: Questions written blind from merged cloudflare/workerd PRs (2026) and a few common tasks, without seeing AGENTS.md; answers labeled separately against the docs `agentindex import` made from it.

labeling.method: Two independent labelers per question (one starting from the doc list, one from grep); a third agent reconciled every disagreement on the merits.

cases.task: [build] Update to Bazel 9.3.0
cases.question: What command builds the workerd binary locally, and do I need bazelisk or a specific Bazel version installed?
cases.note: Bazel section: `bazel build //src/workerd/server:workerd` (output in bazel-bin), or `just build`; bazelisk/Bazel version not covered.

cases.task: Reject locked ReadableStream bodies
cases.question: How do I run a single JavaScript API test, like one defined by a .wd-test file, with Bazel?
cases.note: 'Running a Single Test': `bazel test //src/workerd/api/tests:encoding-test@`; 'Test Variants': required `@` suffix, BUILD.bazel target lookup.

cases.task: Add offpeak_location_hint compat flag for Durable Objects
cases.question: My test for a new compat flag fails because the flag isn't on; how do I enable flags for the test worker in .wd-test?
cases.note: '.wd-test File Format': add the flag to the worker's `compatibilityFlags` list.

cases.task: Test a change that is guarded by a newly added autogate
cases.question: How do I run tests with all autogates enabled, or with just one specific autogate turned on?
cases.note: 'Test Variants': run the `name@all-autogates` target; enabling one specific autogate is covered nowhere.

cases.task: [build] Improve caching and reduce need for Symlink actions
cases.question: Local Bazel builds are extremely slow; is there a remote cache or build config I should use to speed them up?
cases.note: Bazel section: pass `--config=bazelflare` for remote execution if the `cloudflared access token` command prints a token.

cases.task: clang-tidy: readability-inconsistent-ifelse-braces
cases.question: How do I run clang-format and clang-tidy on my C++ changes, and is there a pre-commit hook for this?
cases.note: Just Commands: just format/format-head, just clang-tidy; coding-conventions intro: githooks/pre-commit hook; JSG section: just clang-tidy.

cases.task: Prepare commits and a pull request for a workerd change
cases.question: Are there conventions for commit messages, PR descriptions, and how to split a workerd change into commits?
cases.note: Commit discipline: small compiling, tested commits, no fixups; commit messages hold change narrative; PR descriptions uncovered.

cases.task: Truncate before range-checking JSG integers behind an autogate
cases.question: When should a risky behavior change go behind an autogate rather than a compatibility flag?
cases.note: Autogates: temporary, per-process risky rollouts that don't preserve existing Workers' API surface; behavior changes use compat flags.

cases.task: Add python_zstd_snapshot compat flag
cases.question: How do I add a new compatibility flag, including its enable date and the name of its opposite disable flag?
cases.note: Where to Look: compatibility-date.capnp annotations define flag names and enable dates; Feature Management: document before enable date.

cases.task: Follow the Fetch spec for statusText
cases.question: Does a spec-compliance fix that changes observable behavior need a compatibility flag so existing workers don't break?
cases.note: Yes: deployed features can't change; behavior changes get feature flags in compatibility-date.capnp.

cases.task: Move per-isolate-bootstrap to api
cases.question: What belongs in src/workerd/io versus api, jsg, util and server, and which of those layers may depend on which?
cases.note: Core Directory Structure describes api/, io/, jsg/, server/, util/ roles; which layer may depend on which is not documented.

cases.task: Move node:diagnostics_channel from C++ to TypeScript
cases.question: Should a node: compatibility module be implemented in TypeScript under src/node or in C++, and how is it registered?
cases.note: Where-to-Look: dual-layer, register in api/node/node.h NODEJS_MODULES; directory section: C++ in api/node, TS in src/node; no preference rule.

cases.task: Give Rust APIs the IoContext of the current request
cases.question: What is IoContext, and how should objects tied to one request be held so they're never used from another request?
cases.note: Where to Look: IoContext = per-request god object; anti-patterns: JS-heap refs to KJ I/O objects need IoOwn.

cases.task: Write C++ code in src/workerd that handles optional values, strings and owned pointers
cases.question: Should I use KJ types like kj::Maybe, kj::String and kj::Own instead of std::optional, std::string and std::unique_ptr?
cases.note: Use KJ types, not STL table: kj::String, kj::Own, kj::Maybe instead of std::string, std::unique_ptr, std::optional.

cases.task: Throw TypeError from Response.json() for non-encodable values
cases.question: How should C++ API code throw a JavaScript TypeError — JSG_REQUIRE, KJ_REQUIRE, or a JSG_FAIL variant?
cases.note: Error Handling: JSG_REQUIRE/JSG_FAIL_REQUIRE for JS-facing errors; KJ_REQUIRE is for C++ preconditions. TypeError not named.

cases.task: Visit the reader held by ReadableStream async iterators
cases.question: When a C++ API object holds a jsg::Ref or a JS value, how do I make the garbage collector trace it?
cases.note: Anti-patterns: Ref<T> in JS-visible C++ objects must implement visitForGc(); JSG section: fields traced in visitForGc(), clang-tidy check.

cases.task: workerd: Convert continuation captures to weak handles
cases.question: Is it safe to capture `this` or a jsg::Ref in a promise continuation lambda, or does that risk leaks or use-after-free?
cases.note: JSG section: workerd-unsafe-continuation-capture clang-tidy flags [this]/bare-ref captures in Promise::then; jsg::Ref leaks not covered.

cases.task: Release pipeline on rejected rpc promises
cases.question: Are C++ coroutines with co_await allowed for kj::Promise code, and what lifetime pitfalls should I avoid with them?
cases.note: Anti-pattern: never pass jsg::Lock into KJ promise coroutines; nothing else on co_await pitfalls (architecture only points elsewhere).

cases.task: Add integer support to Rust JSG
cases.question: Where should unit tests for a Rust crate go — an inline tests module or a separate test file?
cases.note: Test Types: Rust unit tests go in <module>-test.rs beside the module, never inline.

cases.task: fix(types): add streamDiagEvent to TailStream.TailEventHandlerObject
cases.question: How do I regenerate the TypeScript type definitions after changing an API, and where do hand-written type overrides go?
cases.note: `just generate-types` (build commands; anti-patterns: never edit generated-snapshot); hand-written types in types/defines/*.d.ts (Where to Look).

cases.task: Update tokio to 1.54.0
cases.question: How do I add or bump a Rust crate dependency so the Bazel build picks up the new version?
cases.note: Rust Development: `just update-rust <package>` updates Rust deps (cargo update equivalent); adding a new crate not covered.

cases.question: What are the steps for updating V8 to a new version, including rebasing workerd's V8 patches?
cases.note: Lists steps (sync source, apply/rebase patches, regenerate patches, bump Bazel deps) and conflict guidance; full steps are in docs/v8-updates.md, outside the knowledge base.
